$comment: Strings the string lint (pnpm ui:lint) accepts that are not catalog messages: the mockup fixtures (UI-KITS.md §8: Tidewater Studio by Harbor Audio, Drift Kart by Lanternworks, Fennick Studio's devices and people), the product's own content the kit only displays (release notes, store prices), glyphs, and values a kit formats rather than translates (keys, codes, versions). Every entry needs a reason. Copy belongs in packages/brand/kit-copy/en.json, never here; a board string that should be copy and is not in the catalog is recorded in strings.debt.json instead.

allow.reason: Glyphs only: separators, status marks, progress bars and spinner frames carry no copy.
Controller and keyboard glyphs (A, B, X, L1, R1): the kits draw them as icon textures.
Fixture product names with tier and version (ProductIdentity values, §4.7).
Fixture tier and term names (license data, not copy).
Fixture developer, organisation and person names.

allow.pattern: Work laptop|Mara’s iPad|Mara’s studio iPad|MacBook Pro|Studio Mac mini|Living room PC|build-server-02
allow.reason: Fixture device names (device records, not copy).
Fixture account emails (masked or not).
License keys, key fragments and sign-in codes are values the kit formats (§1.5 rule 12).
Store prices, percentages, counts, versions and the status-bar time: formatted values.
signin.handoff.url around the customer site's device-code address: the address is a long fixture word, which the matcher's argument-weight guard rejects (it counts letters).
Device-code and release-notes URLs (theme value product.deviceCodeUrl, release data).

allow.pattern: Stem export in one (click|tap), with loudness matching|Stem export in one tap, and fixes|Track freeze (now )?works with every plug-in|Fixes a crash when unplugging an (audio )?interface|Night Circuit: four new tracks after dark|Split-screen for up to four players
allow.reason: Fixture release notes: the product's own release content, shown by the kit, not translated by it.
Fixture session tracks in the host app around the kit.
The command line the person typed, echoed above the program's output (the bin name is the fixture product's).
The --json command lines on the terminal board: the flag, then the exit code echoed or the long line folded.
The --json result line the Node kit prints (machine output, never translated), captured from a gate refusal and a revoked status and folded at 116 columns.
The terminal window's title bar: the fixture product and the command running.
A device id the kit prints for the person to copy (a value, not copy).

allow.pattern: Render quality|Audio volume|Net proxy|Net lockdown|UI compact|UI sounds|Debug logging|Extra [a-g]|\d+
allow.reason: Fixture settings: the entry's label (else its key read as words) and a numeric value, product data the kit displays.
Fixture device and tier names (data, not copy); the straight apostrophe the matrix input carries.

allow.pattern: (Automatic grant|From (Tidewater Studio|Harbor Audio)|Added with a key|Free)( · (Lifetime|Until [\d/]+))?
allow.reason: A license row's meta line: the origin and term joined as the catalog's {origin} · {term}; the whole line is arguments, so the matcher cannot key it.

allow.pattern: [\p{L}\d ]+ · last used \d+ days? ago( · Least recent)?
allow.reason: A device row's meta line: platform, when and the Least recent tag joined; its parts are catalog messages (signin.replace.meta, signin.replace.leastRecent).

allow.pattern: Open Microsoft Store|Get Tidewater Studio|by (Harbor Audio|Lanternworks)
allow.reason: A catalog message that is mostly an argument ({store}, {product}, {developer}), filled with a fixture value.

allow.pattern: Welcome to Tidewater Studio Professional Edition for Teams and Classrooms
allow.reason: The long-product-name fixture in the Welcome title (a ProductIdentity value inside a catalog message).
A release channel's id as the host names it (data, not copy); the kit capitalises it.

allow.pattern: Faster sync\. Fixes a crash on launch\.|Fixes the mixer on Windows\.| Fixes sync\.
allow.reason: Fixture release notes, one of them hostile markup the kit must show as text.
The shell around the output: the command the person typed and the exit code it left (the gate rows pin 4 for a refusal).

allow.pattern: ([|`] )?tidewater (activate|login|import-bundle <file>) (Use a license key|Sign in|Use a different key|Use the license on your account|Activate from an offline activation file)
allow.reason: A fix row: the command the person types beside its catalog verb copy (welcome.useKey, welcome.signIn, cli.fix.*), in the kit's two-column layout and its ASCII rendering.

allow.pattern: ! Activate|\| Enter a license key or sign in to continue\.
allow.reason: The ASCII-symbols rendering of the needs-activation refusal: the catalog title and message after the kit's symbol table swaps the mark.

allow.pattern: (Tidewater Studio Pro · Ready|License Pro · mara@fennick\.studio|Offline until Oct 19|License key · pkey_tidewater_•+|License key You'll find it in your purchase email\.)
allow.reason: Node goldens (boot, status, activate): the fixture product and person and the kit's own lines, as the golden prints them.
The host command's own output after the gate lets it run (host content, not kit copy).

allow.pattern: Usage: tidewater \[options\] \[command\]|Options:|Build:|Commands:|License:|(-v, --verbose <level>|-h, --help|build|export|import|publish <target> \[channel\]|activate \[key\]|status|deactivate|login|devices list|update check|update apply) .+|its seat
allow.reason: Host CLI help as the Node golden help-host prints it: the host's commander lines and headings, with the kit's verbs under License.
Mockup fixture: a license row's tier name and its term chip (signin.term.*), drawn as one row title.

allow.pattern: (Work laptop|Mara’s iPad)( Least recent)?|Mara’s studio workstation in the second-floor mixing room|Living room Mac mini|Pixel tablet|Old desktop|Kitchen iPad|Travel laptop|Studio Mac Pro|Spare tablet|Rehearsal laptop
allow.reason: Mockup fixtures: Mara's device names for the 12-device replace list, with the signin.replace.leastRecent chip.
UpdatePrompt on the web: the kit formats the version into the button (a link out, so the arrow).

allow.pattern: Enter a license key or sign in|to continue\.|tidewater activate|tidewater login|Enter a license key or sign|in to continue\.|This device was signed out\. Sign in|or activate again to continue\.|This device was signed out\.|Sign in or activate again|To keep using|Tidewater Studio:|Use the license on|your account|Use a license key|Sign in|Use a different key|To keep using Tidewater Studio:|Use the license on your account
allow.reason: A catalog sentence or fix row wrapped at the column of the 40- and 32-column frames (gate refusal, revoked status): the Node kit's narrow renders (harness NARROW_VARIANTS) break it there, so each row is a fragment of one catalog string.
Fixture developer byline under the product name (ProductIdentity.developer, §4.7); the kit renders the value, the 'by' is the identity block's own label.

allow.pattern: Mara['’]s (studio )?iPad|Mara['’]s studio workstation in the second-floor mixing room|Harbor Audio account
allow.reason: Fixture device and account names (Fennick Studio's devices, Harbor Audio's account), not copy.

allow.pattern: (Work laptop|Living room PC)( Least recent)? ?(Windows 11 · last used (41 days ago|3 weeks ago))?|(This tablet )?Android 16 · in use now
allow.reason: Fixture device rows: a device name, its least-recent chip and the formatted platform and last-used line (devices.meta), drawn as one row title.

allow.pattern: Cloud Sync Synced 2 min ago|lock On|Share crash reports( Set by Fennick Studio| On · set by Fennick Studio)?|Audio|General|Stable|Beta|Install updates automatically|Send anonymous usage data|Check now|Up to date · checked 2 min ago|Cloud saves|Controls|Video|Online play Set by your parent or guardian|Lifetime · m•••@fennick\.studio|This Mac, Mara['’]s iPad · 2 of 3
allow.reason: Fixture settings: the developer's own config-catalog labels and values (Fennick Studio's catalog), with the kit's 'Set by' source line; the developer writes them, not the kit copy catalog.
Gamepad hint bar: the controller glyph (an icon texture in the kit) and its action word; the action words are the Godot hint bar's own labels.

allow.pattern: \$3\.33/mo Save 33%|14 days free, then \$39\.99 a year|Billed every month|Cancel anytime in Settings\. Renews automatically\.|Everything in Tidewater Studio, on all your devices\.|Monthly Billed every month|Restore|Save 33%|Start free trial|Stem export with loudness matching|Terms|Unlimited tracks and plug-ins|Yearly 14 days free, then \$39\.99 a year
allow.reason: StoreKit paywall: the host app's offer and store terms, which the host supplies (a UK-11 target frame; the kit has no paywall).

allow.pattern: 2 sessions need a choice|3 devices · all updates|Expired Sep 30|Export every track as its own file, loudness-matched\.|Stem export is in Pro|Syncing 3 sessions…|Tidewater Studio is now on this Mac\.
allow.reason: Component gallery sample content: the host's own banner, toast and row text the kit components display.
